conviction_note: The headline cash number (record Q3 free cash flow of about C$20M) was pre-released on 2026-10-15 and the stock has since moved from about US$1.15 to 1.255. What is left is a pre-flagged but unquantified non-cash charge from exiting Canadian dried flower, set against a consensus EPS of -US$0.01 on a name that fell 10-12% on a non-cash-driven EPS miss in Nov 2025 and about 7-10% on the Jul 2026 print. That leans small negative. A pending C$50M substantial issuer bid capped at US$1.35, to be launched after this print, gives a floor and an upside mechanism. Netted, p_up is 47 on a rebuilt abs move of 6%. The findings sum to -1.2 and the scaled number is -0.36; the gap is the SIB floor and the pre-release, which both damp the sign without damping the move.
bar: Consensus EPS -US$0.01 for Q3 2026 (Earnings Whispers https://www.earningswhispers.com/epsdetails/SNDL and StockAlarm https://pro.stockalarm.io/quote/SNDL/analysts agree). Revenue consensus US$171M (~C$236-237M) from StockAlarm only, with 2-5 covering analysts. Revenue is sized against that and against Q3 2025's C$244.2M (https://sndl.com/news/news-details/2025/SNDL-Reports-Third-Quarter-2025-Financial-and-Operational-Results/default.aspx), with the Q1/Q2 2026 trend at -4.4%/-3.7% y/y. The company gives no numeric quarterly guide, only qualitative statements: H2 2026 stronger than H1; >C$20M incremental operating income from profit-enhancement initiatives, mostly in H2; positive full-year FCF. The FCF line is pre-released at ~C$20M (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001766600/000117184326006673/exh_991.htm, 2026-10-15). The revenue bar has a single source, so every finding that depends on it is kept small.
positioning_check: Short interest is not crowded on the latest data found: equibles shows days to cover 1.86 at the 2026-03-13 settlement (https://equibles.com/stocks/sndl/shortinterest), and MarketBeat shows about 1% of float and 0.7 days at 2025-09-15 (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/SNDL/short-interest). No October 2026 figure was found; the Nasdaq short-interest API returned 503. The option chain is unusable (no two-sided ATM legs) so there is no skew. The put/call OI ratio is 0.03 (calls dominate, retail tilt). Run-up is 0.0% over 5 days and -9.7% over 20 days, 44% below the 52-week high and 9% above the low. The 20-day drawdown coincides with the 2026-10-01 stay of the DEA rescheduling hearing (sector). The stock rose from about US$1.15 (Oct 14 close implied by the SIB cap) to 1.255 after the 2026-10-15 pre-release and SIB announcement.

findings.finding: In the 2026-10-15 6-K SNDL said it is exiting the unprofitable Canadian domestic dried-flower category and that 'near-term results may include one-time, mostly non-cash items', with no amount given. The Q2 call (2026-07-28) admitted 'acute issues' at the Kelowna asset and Cannabis Operations gross margin of 1.8%. Against a consensus EPS of -US$0.01, an unquantified impairment or inventory write-down booked in Q3 could produce a headline EPS miss. That is the mechanism behind the Nov 2025 reaction: -US$0.05 vs -US$0.02 consensus, largely non-cash (SBC liability, write-downs), and the stock fell about 10-12%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 (2025-11-04 bmo): EPS -0.05 vs -0.02 consensus driven by non-cash items; the stock fell ~10.5% pre-market and ~12% on the day (https://www-web.itiger.com/news/1167360584). Q2 2026 (2026-07-28 bmo): operating loss widened on Jeeter ramp costs; the stock fell ~7% per Intellectia (https://intellectia.ai/news/stock/sndl-reports-q2-revenue-decline-shares-drop-nearly-7), -9.63% on the baseline bar for that date.
findings.why_not_priced: The charge was flagged but not quantified, and both the timing (Q3 or Q4) and the size are unknown. A -US$0.01 consensus from two to five analysts shows estimates were not cut for a charge; if they had been, consensus would sit at -0.03 or worse. The stock rose after the release on the FCF and SIB headlines, not on this line.
findings.independence: Q2 2026 call transcript (https://s201.q4cdn.com/372870431/files/doc_earnings/2026/q2/transcript/final-sndl-inc-q2-2026-results.pdf, 2026-07-28): Kelowna 'acute issues', Jeeter inefficiencies 'expected to persist over the coming months', and a stated move away from domestic flower. The same company is the source for both; no third party confirms it.

findings.finding: The board directed management to pursue a substantial issuer bid of up to C$50M at a maximum of C$1.92 (US$1.35) per share. At the cap that is roughly 26M shares, about 11% of the 243.8M outstanding. Launch is 'after Q3 earnings', subject to approvals, so the bid's terms (form, price range) are likely to be announced with or right after the 2026-10-27 release. Spot is US$1.255, 7% below the cap.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-10-15 announcement of the SIB with the record-FCF pre-release took the stock from about US$1.15 to ~1.21-1.25 over the next sessions (+5.2% and +3.3% on the baseline's 10-14/10-15 bars). No prior SIB by this company to compare.
findings.why_not_priced: The intent is public and partly priced: the stock rose ~9% from the Oct 14 close. The terms are not. A Dutch-auction range whose floor sits at or above spot would pull the stock up toward it; a range under spot would disappoint. Two things are uncertain: whether the terms are announced inside the window, and where the range sits. If the market had fully priced a cap-price tender for 11% of the float, spot would sit nearer US$1.30-1.35.
findings.independence: This shares a document with the FCF finding and the AGCO finding (one 6-K, three separate lines). Q2 call (2026-07-28): the CEO said the equity 'is trading well below its intrinsic value' and that repurchases are an attractive use of capital; Q2 repurchases were 11.7M shares at US$1.43. Same company, different document. The failed share-consolidation vote (54.1% vs a two-thirds requirement, same 6-K) is context only.

findings.finding: Q3 2026 free cash flow was pre-released at ~C$20M (C$19.954M), a company record. About C$10.6M of it comes from the initial unwind of a captive insurance arrangement, net of premiums. Underlying FCF is therefore about C$9.4M, against C$16.7M in Q3 2025 (with no such item), so the cash quality of the quarter is weaker than the headline. Q3 also had about 5.4M shares repurchased.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 printed a then-record FCF of C$16.7M and the stock still fell ~10-12% on the EPS miss (https://www-web.itiger.com/news/1167360584). This name has not paid for FCF headlines on print day.
findings.why_not_priced: The headline is priced: it is pre-released and the stock rose on it. The one-off composition is in the same release, but retail wire coverage led with 'record free cash flow', so the full MD&A walk on 10-27 may land the weaker underlying figure for the first time. Most of this is priced, hence the small size.
findings.independence: Shares the 2026-10-15 6-K with the two findings above. Q3 2025 comparison from the company's Q3 2025 release (https://sndl.com/news/news-details/2025/SNDL-Reports-Third-Quarter-2025-Financial-and-Operational-Results/default.aspx).

findings.finding: The Canadian cannabis demand read for Jun-Aug 2026 is mixed to weak for SNDL's wholesale and retail lines. Tilray (quarter ended 2026-08-31, reported 2026-10-08, after SNDL last reported) said Canadian adult-use sales fell 16% y/y and it lost share. SNDL's own Q2 cannabis retail same-store sales were -4.6% with 'market contraction in Alberta and Ontario', and Cannabis Operations revenue was -10.1% y/y with B2B flower deliveries absent. On the other side, StatCan national legal cannabis retail sales were a record C$517.8M in June 2026, +7.8% y/y. Cannabis is about 43% of revenue; liquor (57%) is covered separately.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 cannabis-operations margin collapse (1.8% GM) coincided with the ~7-10% fall on 2026-07-28.
findings.why_not_priced: This is a peer print landing after SNDL last spoke on operations (Jul 28; the Oct 15 release gave no revenue). Consensus revenue of ~C$237M is flat against Q2, implying no further sector deterioration. This is a proxy, not a counterparty, so it stays small.
findings.independence: Proxy. SNDL Q2 call (https://s201.q4cdn.com/372870431/files/doc_earnings/2026/q2/transcript/final-sndl-inc-q2-2026-results.pdf) for its own SSS. The national StatCan series points the other way (June record, reported via https://tobaccoinsider.com/cannabis-canada/, page not fully readable), which is why this is sized small.

findings.finding: Liquor retail, 57% of revenue, ran Q2 2026 same-store sales of -6.2%, revenue of -5.1% y/y, gross margin down 60bp on promotions, and adjusted operating income of C$3.2M vs C$6.7M. Management guided flat-or-better H2 liquor margins. The Alberta liquor store industry is in structural decline (-1.2% a year 2021-2026 per IBISWorld). There is no Q3-specific series showing a turn.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Liquor weakness was part of both the Q3 2025 and Q2 2026 negative reactions (~-10-12% and ~-7-10%).
findings.why_not_priced: The H2 margin recovery is the company's guide, and a flat revenue consensus assumes it. A continued -5 to -6% SSS against a guided margin turn would be the miss. This is a weak lean, inferred from trend, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: IBISWorld Alberta beer/wine/liquor stores profile (https://www.ibisworld.com/canada/industry/alberta/beer-wine-liquor-stores/15075/, March 2026) is an industry proxy.

findings.finding: SNDL reached an agreement in principle with Ontario's AGCO over its de facto control of Spiritleaf/Superette Ontario stores: a C$200,000 fine, third-party financing, and a modified franchise model that deconsolidates the associated retail revenue while 'preserving net economics'. The deconsolidation will reduce reported revenue in future periods and may be quantified on the call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance. The AGCO pre-enforcement notice surfaced via the Globe and Mail on 2026-06-15 (https://stratcann.com/?p=49411).
findings.why_not_priced: It is disclosed, but the revenue to be deconsolidated was not quantified. A revenue-reset number on the call would hit a retail tape that reads headline revenue. Most of the regulatory risk is resolved (a licence-revocation threat turned into a small fine), which offsets.
findings.independence: Shares the 2026-10-15 6-K. StratCann on the April 2026 AGCO pre-enforcement notice (https://stratcann.com/?p=49411).

findings.finding: SNDL's indirect interest in Parallel (Surterra; FL/TX/MA medical cannabis, 56 stores, ~US$150M annualised revenue) rose from ~67% to ~92% via a rights offering. SunStream is funding a wholly owned Gainesville, FL facility. Direct control and consolidation, which would make SNDL the first Nasdaq-listed company consolidating US medical cannabis operations, is expected 'in the coming months'. A timing update or Nasdaq clearance on the call is a possible positive catalyst.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Parallel completion on 2026-07-27 came the day before the Q2 print, and the print still fell ~7-10%; that milestone did not carry the tape.
findings.why_not_priced: Consolidation timing is undated. A firm date or Nasdaq sign-off would be news, and a retail cannabis tape bids on US exposure. If it were priced, the stock would not sit 44% below its 52-week high with a 20-day drawdown. Timing within the window is uncertain, hence the small size.
findings.independence: Q2 2026 MD&A, 6-K exhibit 99.2 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001766600/000119312526318366/sndl-ex99_2.htm, 2026-07-27): control expected 'in the coming months' subject to legal, regulatory, accounting and Nasdaq requirements. Same company.

outside_window.finding: The DEA ALJ temporarily stayed the broader marijuana rescheduling proceedings (order of ~2026-09-29, reported 2026-10-01) pending a government response due 2026-10-13. No ruling date exists. This sector catalyst is the likely cause of the 20-day -9.7% drawdown, and its resolution is not dated inside the window.
outside_window.resolves_by: undated; no ALJ recommendation timeline announced

outside_window.finding: The normal course issuer bid expires 2026-11-20 and the company intends to renew it. It cannot run concurrently with the SIB.

baseline_tension: No skew is available. The run-up is -9.7% over 20 days with a bounce since the 10-15 SIB/FCF release. The small negative lean (unquantified flower-exit charge vs a -US$0.01 bar, on a name that sells its prints) goes with the 20-day drawdown, and the SIB floor cuts against it, so p_up sits only 3 points below 50.
lessons_applied: Lesson 3 (caveat reaches the number): SIB finding cut from +0.8 to +0.6, because the launch terms may not be announced inside the window.

Lesson 2 (unquantified reported-quarter impairment is the exception that pays) plus reaction history: the flower-exit charge stays at -1.0 under reported_quarter rather than being shrunk as a one-off.

Lesson 'reaction history from wrong events': base rate rebuilt from confirmed prints, abs_move_pct raised from 5.5 to 6.0 and p_up from 48 to 47 after re-weighting the two confirmed large negative print-day reactions.
Lessons 1, 5, 6 and 9 left the other sizes standing: they were already small, proxy-labelled and net of the other segment, and the EPS bar has two agreeing sources.
